title: Add Account failure cleanup

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Cancel, auth capture timeout, login verification failure, live-auth mutation, duplicate captured identity, and save failures must clean isolated Add Account state and save no unintended account.
Startup prompt failures must preserve useful sanitized diagnostics without emitting device codes or auth URL query strings.
Stale isolated CODEX_HOME cleanup must remove old CodexPill session directories without deleting fresh sessions or unrelated directories.

targetSurface: CodexPill Add Account fake-client failure boundary

nonClaims: Does not prove native device-code panel rendering or browser sign-in.
Does not prove live Codex auth, live Codex process termination, or real app quit handling.
Does not prove app crash simulation.
Does not prove live macOS menu-bar behavior.
